title: Publish moving Board test fixtures through real Git

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage

**Caught.** The maintained assertion checks the actual trunk through the Dashboard HOME while the shared REST listing is held. When the publisher skipped the Git advance, that assertion found A instead of B and failed before releasing the listing.

## Selected promise

SEED-430#publish-moving-board-fixtures-through-git at `eaeeec7ea4ccfbc5253ea88223e8895fa91c9082`.

The story requires Git and successful REST answers to name the same commit at each publication. Slice 8 keeps the shared `matching-refs` hold at the scheduled request and checks the routed pin before releasing it. This probe covers the held-listing case in `e2e/observation/shared-observer-reads.spec.ts:203`.

## Fault and observation

In `dashboard/test-support/publishedMovingOrigin.ts:81`, I made `publishMain(origin, revision)` run only for the starting publication. The subsequent REST `push(revision, backlog, files)` still executes and assigns its own main to B. The named history, request hold, test case, and assertions stayed intact.

All three runs used the same command in a detached scratch worktree at the selected revision. The locked npm install and Chromium prerequisite check passed on AC power.

```sh
env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_TRACE_PACKET='/private/tmp/dough-intent-moving-board.M9BIHc/packets.log' caffeinate -s -i npm run test:e2e -- e2e/observation/shared-observer-reads.spec.ts --grep 'revision checks from two tabs share one head listing' --workers=1 --reporter=line
```

- **Baseline.** One Chromium case passed. Git packet output advertised `5efd647dea763d8bafdf9b1712801014f42062f7` at A and `5d1fb3be5407886c4d380087a20d0ff7d2bfc9e7` at B.
- **Fault.** One Chromium case failed after the maintained waiter and single `matching-refs` assertions passed and `origin.advanceTo("B")` returned. The Git packet output independently recorded `9843b6c7c7ba6c8811599bfd7b91dbbcecd05717` for both `refs/heads/main` reads. The assertion at `e2e/observation/shared-observer-reads.spec.ts:233` reported that A value while expecting `d99eea78d69d3b56c862d761051c7775eebb5c1d` for B.
- **Restored.** I restored and byte-compared the publisher, verified the tracked and untracked status matched the original empty record, and reran the same case. It passed, with Git advertising `5e247bdc3954b28048ddc6b4ff0c2040e9461712` at A and `08925141b3763b54929bede1b92c4538be5b2161` at B. I removed the scratch worktree and verified that its path and Git registration were gone.

The fault was caught before release, so the faulted run does not supply a REST response after the hold. The two passing runs exercised release and checked the changed REST reply and exact B backlog request. This verdict is limited to the suppressed Git move in this journey.

**Next proof action.** Keep the maintained assertion. This probe found no need for additional proof on the examined path. The planned fixture qualification still owns the cross-suite audit.

The verbatim report and supporting logs are at `/private/tmp/dough-intent-moving-board.M9BIHc/report.md` and in its parent directory.

## Cost

- **Test runtime.** Baseline 12.5 s and restored 4.6 s, measured by the Playwright summaries. The faulted line reporter gave the verdict without a duration.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human participated in the probe.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. The host provided no separate agent-effort measure.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 186906 ms (measured), from 1795606048223 to 1795606235129 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

eaeeec7ea4ccfbc5253ea88223e8895fa91c9082. Caught. Keep the maintained assertion. No follow-up.
